packageRules.description: Wait three days before proposing a new npm or PyPI release, so a compromised or yanked release can be caught first
Solid 2.0's prereleases only work at matching versions
Effect's packages are released together and depend on matching versions. @effect/tsgo is tooling with its own releases
The Playwright Docker image's browsers must match the Playwright npm packages
drizzle-kit generates migrations for the drizzle-orm version it ships with
Released together from cloudflare/workers-sdk. miniflare is left out because its stable releases stopped, and @cloudflare/workers-types comes from workerd
Keep packageManager, setup-bun and @types/bun on the same Bun release
